witness.acip: DE'I BSHAD SBYAR DGE BSNYEN BTZUN PAS MDZAD PAR, CHU KLUNG GI DNGOS PO LA RANG RANG GI LAS KYI RNAM SMIN GYI DBANG GIS YI DVAGS KYIS RNAG LA SOGS PAS GANG BAR MTHONG BA DANG, DE NYID LA DUD 'GRO NYA LA SOGS PAS GNAS KYI BLOS GNAS PAR BYED PA DANG,
witness.wylie: de'i bshad sbyar dge bsnyen btsun pas mdzad par, chu klung gi dngos po la rang rang gi las kyi rnam smin gyi dbang gis yi dvags kyis rnag la sogs pas gang bar mthong ba dang, de nyid la dud 'gro nya la sogs pas gnas kyi blos gnas par byed pa dang
witness.english: The explanation of this work by the layperson with lifetime vows named “Holy One” though does give the following explanation— Each one, according to the power of their own karmic ripening, sees the stream of fresh water in a different way. The craving spirit sees it filled with pus and the like. An animal like a fish or the like sees the very same object as being their home, and they want to reside in it.
